translations.web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
translations.bsb: With deceit in his heart he devises evil; he continually sows discord.
translations.kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
translations.asv: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.
